    - link "Back to search":
      - /url: /pricing?customer=C002
  - heading "51001-A Display carton" [level=1]
  - paragraph: C002 · Globex Retail S.A. · EUR
  - table "Price versions":
    - caption: Price versions
    - rowgroup:
      - row "Version Price Currency Valid from Valid to Status":
        - columnheader "Version"
        - columnheader "Price"
        - columnheader "Currency"
        - columnheader "Valid from"
        - columnheader "Valid to"
        - columnheader "Status"
        - columnheader

  - text: Price
  - textbox "Price"
  - text: Valid from
  - textbox "Valid from":
    - /placeholder: YYYY-MM-DD
